stem: A learner is tracing where a lateral branch originates on a cannabis stem. Which structure should be identified first?
choices: An internode, because branches originate from the middle of internodes
A node, because leaves, axillary buds, and branches are organized there
A root cap, because it determines shoot branching
A mature seed coat, because it produces vegetative shoots
rationale: Nodes are repeated structural positions on the stem where leaves and axillary growth can arise; internodes are the stem segments between nodes.
